LangGraph._comment: Host is DELIBERATELY ABSENT here. It used to default to http://localhost:2024, which is only ever correct on a developer machine — and because that is a well-formed absolute http URI the startup validation passed it, so a deployment that never set LangGraph__Host booted green and then POSTed every uploaded menu at its own loopback interface (issue #94). The dev value now lives in appsettings.Development.json beside UseStubExtractor; anywhere else this key is required and the API refuses to start without it. ExtractTimeoutSeconds is also a transaction-hold budget — the call runs inside the ingestion inbox transaction — and Secrets:LangGraphMenuExtractionKey is required outside Development too.
